comparison.objective: Share one screwdriver, rather than use a mandrel and hammer to break and recover tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Shared-tool handoff and screw-driving alignment/rotation versus simultaneous bimanual mandrel stabilization, striking, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies successful work using one shared screwdriver; referenced details, fastening targets, and rubric are absent. It does not specify notch fracture or containment of released parts.
comparison.reason: Generic tool alignment is shared, but screwdriver rotation and resource sharing do not test the candidate's impact-fracture mechanism.
